description: Retrieves recorded training metrics for a fine-tuning job in chronological order. All query parameters are optional: omit them to retrieve all metrics.

schema.description: Fine-tune job ID. A string that starts with `ft-`.

parameters.description: Return only metrics with global_step >= this value.
parameters.name: global_step_from

parameters.description: Return only metrics with global_step <= this value.
parameters.name: global_step_to

parameters.description: Return only metrics logged at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: logged_at_from

parameters.description: Return only metrics logged at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: logged_at_to

parameters.description: Number of (uniformly sampled) train metrics to return.
parameters.name: resolution

items.description: A flat dictionary of scalar metric values.

200.description: List of metrics snapshots in chronological order.

400.description: Invalid request: bad JSON body or missing job ID.

500.description: Internal server error: failed to retrieve metrics.
